panels.description: In the courtyard-office doorway, Bua-ji stands squarely with the torn sale tab while Saand and his two apologetic goons face her. A wall calendar still shows several days before the pre-Diwali opening deadline, making clear the deadline is ahead and sabotage—not ordinary lateness—caused the interruption. Keep upper-left clear.
Bua-ji hands the torn sale tab to Saand. His self-assured posture remains fixed. Keep the top third open.
At GODARAZ, Bua-ji directs a new power contractor while Pinty studies the service plan. Guddu reaches toward the plan, then lets Pinty take it. Keep the plan and upper third clear.
A truck arrives outside GODARAZ carrying a tall covered rectangular mural object. Guddu and Bua-ji look toward it; the recovered dhurrie lies at the entrance. Keep upper-right sky clear.

items.speaker: BUA-JI
items.text: A loan is a loan. Sabotage is not failure.

items.speaker: BUA-JI
items.text: The warehouse is not for sale.

items.speaker: PINTY
items.text: This one has an earth connection.
